استعلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَوْا (istaʕlaw) /is.taʕ.law/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
# اِسْتَعْلُوا (istaʕlū) /is.taʕ.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
